sources.entry: Alchemy - Experimental, open-source drawing application with an emphasis on creating conceptual art. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://svn.al.chemy.org/)

summary.name: Alchemy
summary.one_liner: Alchemy is an experimental open-source drawing project for sketching and brainstorming visually on computers, rather than producing finished artwork.
summary.what_it_does: Alchemy is an open drawing project that explores new ways to sketch, draw, and create on computers. It is a sketching environment focused on the initial stage of creation rather than producing finished artwork. The page says it supports serendipitous visual brainstorming. The project also runs hands-on workshops, talks, and exercises on experimental drawing. Version 008 was released as a Beta, and the project opened development so users can write their own modules in Java, JavaScript, ActionScript, or Processing.
notable: Open to community-written modules in Java, JavaScript, ActionScript, or Processing
Designed for early-stage visual brainstorming rather than finished artwork
Version 008 Beta release, featured in German design magazine Page (May 2010)
caveats: Page describes a 2010-era Beta release (version 008); current status is not stated
Supported operating systems are not named on the page
